company.name: Halter
company.shortDescription: Halter is an agtech company that develops a smart collar for cattle that enables virtual fencing and real-time monitoring.
company.description: Halter provides GPS-enabled collars and software that help farmers monitor and control cattle movement. Its system uses virtual fencing to guide animals without physical barriers, allowing users to manage grazing patterns and land use through a mobile interface. The platform collects data on animal location, behavior, and health indicators, supporting day-to-day farm operations and decision-making. Halter also enables remote shifting of herds, reducing the need for manual labor in moving livestock. Its services are used in agricultural settings to improve pasture utilization and streamline herd management processes.

productsAndServices.description: A cattle-management system combining solar-powered GPS collars with a mobile app and farm connectivity to create virtual fences, move herds remotely, and monitor animal location, behavior, pasture use, heat, and health.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round

insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.
caveats: Crunchbase reports 16 rounds but provides 10 detailed rows.

insights.statement: 5 disclosed grants total $404,614, representing 0.1% of reported funding.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $138,660,432 to $2,000,000,000, a 14.42x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
